content.short: LimeWire is back as an AI studio for images, music and video, with encrypted file sharing and the LMWR token.
content.description: The LimeWire name once meant peer-to-peer music sharing, and today it covers two things. One is an AI studio for creating images, music and video. The other is a file-sharing service with end-to-end encrypted cloud storage, built on BNB Greenfield. The LMWR token pays for services and rewards creators. It also powers Blocknode, a marketplace for decentralized GPU compute. Since its 2022 relaunch the sharing service has attracted millions of people and companies, and large files can be sent without signing up.
